data.one_liner: A time picker widget for selecting hours and minutes as durations.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Material Design-inspired dial widget and dialog for picking durations like hours and minutes. Users can drag the dial around or tap values to select time.
use_when: You need a user to select a specific duration of time such as for timers or snooze settings.
You want an interactive dial component that matches Material Design principles.
avoid_when: You need a standard date picker or calendar instead of a duration.
You need a standard text-based time of day picker (use the built-in showTimePicker).
strengths: Supports both inline embedding and dialog display modes.
Customizable via themes and supports localization for multiple languages.
weaknesses: Limited built-in language translations (only English, German, and Korean currently documented).
